e: From Middle English that, from Old English þæt (“the, that”, neuter definite article and relative pronoun).
q: But more particulary that, / Where Lady was to wear a Hat; / And lay the Enſigns of their pride; / Their Silken Ornaments aſide; / Which would have been a wholſome Act, / T' encourage Woolen Manufact; […]
